title: Layer 0: phantom co-author trailers on public main (fabricated domain identities from the June-era attribution practice)
description: GitHub renders the repo with a fake multi-person author cast: June-era Phase 1a commits carry Co-Authored-By trailers with fabricated domain identities (so@vsdd-domains, tw@vsdd-domains, dr@, pe@, security@, sa@, aie@, qe@, vsdd-methodology@ — plus one malformed trailer-shaped sentence), which GitHub parses into author chips ('7 people' on the repo home). Git author/committer fields are clean (single identity, all branches); trailer emails are fabricated or anthropic-noreply — attribution pollution, not identity leakage. Practice is dead in respec-era commits and contradicts the ratified contract (reviewer roles are signed tracker identities, never git co-authors). Retroactive removal = message rewrite rehashing history — the same vehicle as the driver-key blob purge (#656); the two items share one rewrite decision. Interim mitigation available: pushing current main (61 ahead) replaces the repo-home facepile with current-commit authors. Evidence: trailer enumeration over main history recorded on #597, 2026-07-20; screenshot provided by operator.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Operator ruling 2026-07-20 (decision on #597): retroactive cleanup bundles with the #656 rewrite decision — one rewrite-and-force-push event would cover both this issue's trailer stripping and the driver-key blob purge, decided after the cross-persona audit. Going-forward half is closed by ruling: no domain trailers ever again; the Claude model trailer stays. This issue remains open pending the bundled rewrite decision.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: RE-HOME (not closing) — real integrity debt (phantom co-author trailers / fabricated domain identities on main), mislabeled 'Layer 0' (retired horizontal decomposition). Re-framed off Layer-0; remains open. Route to the Security/integrity lane.
